operators.name: embedding_forward
semantics: Implements torch.nn.Embedding forward: gather rows of weight according to indices.
Input indices shape [batch, seq], weight shape [num_embeddings, embedding_dim], output shape [batch, seq, embedding_dim].
Out-of-range indices are not expected; behavior can be undefined for invalid indices.

operators.name: layer_norm_forward
semantics: Implements torch.nn.functional.layer_norm without weight and bias (pure normalization).
For each row of length normalized_shape over the last dimension, compute mean and variance (biased estimator, i.e. divide by N).
This matches reference F.layer_norm call which does not pass weight/bias.
Embedding lookup using indices x and embedding.weight.
Input indices int64 on cuda, weight float32 on cuda.
Layer normalization over last dimension (normalized_shape=(300,)) without affine parameters (weight/bias not passed).
Computes mean and variance per sample over last 300 elements, normalizes with eps=1e-05.
Returns the layer_norm output tensor, same as step_002 value.
